headline: Pricing power lifts sales and profit despite cost pressure
summary_short: Q2 2026 net sales rose 12.0% y/y to $1,219.7 million, and diluted EPS grew 12.5% to $2.88 from $2.56, as price increases across all three segments offset higher input costs and gross margin slipped 50 basis points.
summary_long: Net sales rose 12.0% y/y to $1,219.7M as pricing actions to offset higher input costs, plus acquisitions and favorable foreign exchange, lifted all three segments; Americas Welding grew on stronger industrial demand and automation project volumes, while International Welding fell on slowing European activity and the Middle East conflict. Gross margin slipped 50bps on unfavorable mix and higher input costs, partly offset by a smaller LIFO charge than a year ago. SG&A rose on RISE initiative spend, acquisitions and FX translation but fell as a share of sales on operating leverage. Diluted EPS rose 12.5% y/y to $2.88 ($2.93 adjusted). Cash fell to $242.4M after $56.7M of Q2 buybacks and continued dividends; management guides to $110-130M of 2026 capital expenditures.

drivers.explanation: Grew on price actions across all three segments to offset higher input costs, plus acquisitions and FX; Americas Welding gained on stronger industrial demand and automation volumes while International Welding fell on slowing European activity and the Middle East conflict.
Rose on higher sales, though margin fell 50bps on unfavorable product mix and higher input costs, partly offset by a smaller LIFO charge than the prior-year quarter.
Grew as pricing gains outpaced higher input costs and SG&A rose slower than sales on operating leverage, despite added RISE strategic-initiative and acquisition-related spend.
Increased in line with higher operating income, partly offset by a higher effective tax rate (23.7% vs 21.9%) on the mix and timing of discrete tax items.
Grew roughly in line with net income; diluted share count fell slightly (55.1M vs 55.3M q/q) on share repurchases, adding a small additional lift.
Fell to $242.4M from $298.9M q/q after $56.7M of share repurchases for treasury and continued dividend payments in the quarter.
Management gave no explicit revenue or EPS outlook, but stated it anticipates $110-130M of full-year 2026 capital expenditures for capacity, efficiency and general maintenance investments.
